name: model-runner-selectable-model-variants
instr:
Ollama cannot discover and select one independently runnable model variant from directories containing alternate checkpoints, quantizations, shard families, or archives. Add that choice to artifact creation, storage, model management, tagging, pulling, inspection, and scheduling so runtime receives exactly the selected weights. Preserve existing behavior without a selection.

Discovery must produce traversal-independent identifiers, ordering, format, completeness, selectability, and canonical weight membership for GGUF, Safetensors, and DDUF, respecting their family and metadata semantics. File, explicit-path, and directory builders must resolve the same stable variant identities: they accept an explicit selector, reject ambiguity when no unique default exists, and report an unknown selector with the available stable identifiers. Ambiguous, unknown, incomplete, missing, stale, or format-incompatible selections must never fall back, publish a tag, report premature success, or configure a runner.

Selected artifacts contain only selected weights, retain eligible companion files, and serialize enough identity and membership to reconstruct the selection after storage or tagging. Unselected single-variant behavior retains its digest, layer order, metadata, Docker or CNCF output, pull status sequence, and format-based backend precedence.

The format package exposes `Variant`, `VariantSelector`, `Format.DiscoverVariants`, `DetectFromPath`, `ErrVariantAmbiguous` as `errors.New("ambig
